label: Remake outputs for the fictional brand Aamod: generated once on Vertex AI and committed.

IN-TN.direction: Tamil Nadu Deepavali evening. Replace the star-shaped paper lantern with a traditional brass standing lamp (kuthuvilakku) glowing warmly, and hang strings of jasmine. Show adhirasam and murukku on the brass plates in place of the chakli and karanji. Keep the dark teal wooden table, the camera angle and the clean empty areas.
IN-TN.note: The model's PNG, re-encoded to JPEG quality 88 to keep the repository small. Layout reference: the key visual plate with the logo, tin and tagline pasted in.

speech.text: தீபாவளி வந்தால் வீடு முழுக்க பலகார மணம் வீசும்.
பாட்டி கையால் செய்த அதிரசம், உக்காரை, லட்டு…
அதே வீட்டுச் சுவை, இப்போது ஆமோத் ஃபெஸ்டிவ் டின்னில்.
இந்தப் பண்டிகையில் உங்கள் அன்பானவர்களுக்கு இனிய பரிசைக் கொடுங்கள்.

IN-TN.prompt: A short, calm festive advertising shot for an audience in Tamil Nadu (Tamil-speaking). Product: Aamod Festive Tin. A reusable peacock-teal tin with a brass-gold lid holding about 750 g of traditional festive sweets and savouries. The assortment follows the region; the tin is the same everywhere. The campaign says: Home-style festive sweets, ready to gift and delivered before the festival day. Pacing follows the original film (its settings: A balcony of an apartment building at dusk, decorated for Diwali; A home dining table in the evening; A carved wooden table with lamps and marigolds); the first frame, not the film, decides what is shown. The first frame is the finished scene. Keep its framing and composition. The camera is locked off: no zoom, pan or tilt. Keep the upper and lower bands of the frame clear and calm for brand graphics. Brand graphics are added afterwards in editing: never draw or change any logo, label or lettering, and keep the product tin as it is. Gentle, natural motion only: flickering lamp light, a soft breeze moving garlands and flowers, a little steam. No new people appear. No text, letters, subtitles, captions or watermarks anywhere. Photographic and realistic, warm light consistent with the first frame.
IN-TN.negative_prompt: text, letters, subtitles, captions, watermark, extra logos, warped packaging, distorted product, blurry, low quality
IN-TN.start_frame: tn_scene.jpg (the Remake: Visuals scene) with the logo and tagline of keyvisual.png wiped out (a smooth fill from the pixels around), the tin of keyvisual.png kept, the legibility scrim applied, contained on a 720x1280 canvas
IN-TN.observed: Reviewed at 0, 1.5, 3, 4.5 and 5.9 s: the camera stays locked, the lamp flames flicker and jasmine petals drift; no logo, tagline or lettering appears anywhere in the model's clip and the tin stays coherent. The logo, tagline, tin and Tamil headline are NOT in this file: a demo run draws them in code over every frame and compares them in frames sampled every 0.5 s (all four held for all 12 sampled frames in the live run that made this clip).
IN-TN.note: The file is the model's MP4 exactly as delivered (no audio, 24 fps), not re-encoded and without the code-drawn brand elements.
